featured.intro: English Vocabulary Daily is a channel that teaches one English word in the morning and tests it with a quiz in the evening. The whole channel runs on GitHub Actions — a scheduled workflow picks the day's lesson deterministically and posts it, twice a day, every day. There is no AI at runtime, no server, and no manual posting: the {{data.lessonCount}}-lesson bank lives in the public repo, and the bot token and chat ID live only as GitHub Secrets, never in the code.
featured.oneLine: A channel that posts one English word in the morning and a quiz in the evening — fully automated on GitHub Free.
featured.result: Posts twice a day, every day, with zero manual work — schedule 07:15 and 17:15 UTC, verifiable in the repo's Actions history.
featured.title: English Vocabulary Daily
